coordinated_activities.activity: Working a night shift as an aged-care support worker at a residential aged care facility, doing resident checks, personal care rounds and handover notes
Commuting home from the night shift by train and bus, listening to quiet audio and keeping to the planned route
Making a pot of tea and a small flexitarian breakfast, keeping noise minimal and putting dishes straight into the dishwasher
Showering and completing a short written wind-down routine before daytime sleep
Sleeping after the night shift with the fan on and the phone set to silent, with a written do-not-disturb note on the door
Eating a late lunch of rice and vegetables cooked in the rice cooker, drinking tea and reviewing the weekly budget in cash
Resting quietly, reading incoming text messages and checking the unit timetable and reminders on the phone
Commuting by train and bus from Clayton to the Monash University campus for coursework
Attending Master of Social Work coursework seminars and a group project meeting on campus, taking detailed written notes
Commuting home from campus by bus and train while reading over placement notes
Batch-cooking a flexitarian dinner of lentils, vegetables and rice, and packing a portion for the next shift
Eating dinner with a cup of tea and wiping down the shared bench and stovetop
Washing up and drying the dishes, then clearing and labelling the food containers in the refrigerator
Writing next week's reminders and shift roster into the paper planner and checking the weekly budget against receipts
Studying course readings and drafting an assignment on the computer at the desk with the desk lamp on
Running a load of laundry in the washing machine and tidying personal items in the bathroom
Sending text messages to family in China and looking at the photo of the family dog
Drinking a cup of tea and doing a calm breathing exercise to settle anxiety before bed
Brushing teeth and completing the evening personal care routine
Sleeping in Bedroom 1 with the fan on low and the phone charging on silent
